orderFormPhoto.hint: A photo of the birthday child — used as the centrepiece of the birthday page.

orderFormMeta.hint: A short message or poem for the birthday page.
orderFormMeta.placeholder: e.g. Happy first birthday, Leo! We love you to the moon and back.

orderFormPhoto.hint: A photo of the favourite toy — placed on the left page with a caption.

orderFormMeta.hint: Name the toy and add a word or two about it.
orderFormMeta.placeholder: e.g. Bunny — Leo's constant companion since day one.

orderFormPhoto.hint: A photo capturing those first steps — placed on the left page with a caption.

orderFormMeta.hint: A short note about the moment.
orderFormMeta.placeholder: e.g. First wobbly steps — 14 March 2024, at home in the kitchen.

orderFormPhoto.hint: Two pieces of artwork — one per page. Scan or photograph flat on a surface.
